notes: Run on the head of the pull request that added revoke --ledger and rotate --ledger, before it was merged as the commit named here. Changes made in review after the run (among them --expect-signer) have not been run on hardware.
Reject was seen for key sign only. A rejection of a revoke or rotate request has not been seen on hardware.
Timeout: both key-event commands, left unanswered for the default 10 minutes. Disconnect: the device reset during a rotate request.
The device's passphrase changed between two attempts, so the same path gave another address. --expect-signer exists because of that.
